# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer decorators. Do not edit. -->

Every command is `microflow [group] command [options] [arguments]`. Run `microflow --help`
or `microflow <group> --help` for the same information in a terminal.

## Top-level commands

### `microflow version`

Print the MicroFlow version.

Usage: `microflow version`

### `microflow validate-config`

Validate a configuration file and, optionally, the images it references.

Usage: `microflow validate-config <config_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | Pipeline YAML configuration file. |
| option | `--check-images` | `False` | Also read each image header and check it. |

### `microflow preprocess`

Apply preprocessing steps and write the result with a provenance sidecar.

Usage: `microflow preprocess <input_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `input_path` |  | Input TIFF or .npy image. |
| option | `--output` |  | Output TIFF; written as float64. |
| option | `--steps` |  | YAML file listing preprocessing steps in order. |
| option | `--flatfield` |  | Flat-field reference image with axes YX. |
| option | `--pixel-size` |  | Pixel size; overrides the file's calibration. Needs --unit. |
| option | `--unit` |  | Length unit for --pixel-size: nm, um, mm or m. |
| option | `--preview` |  | Write a before/after PNG of the first plane. |

### `microflow segment`

Segment objects and write a label image plus a JSON sidecar.

Usage: `microflow segment <input_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `input_path` |  | Input TIFF or .npy image. |
| option | `--output` |  | Output label image (int32; 0 is background). |
| option | `--config` |  | YAML file with segmentation settings. |
| option | `--reference` |  | Ground-truth label image; reports Dice and IoU against it. |
| option | `--pixel-size` |  | Pixel size; overrides the file's calibration. Needs --unit. |
| option | `--unit` |  | Length unit for --pixel-size: nm, um, mm or m. |

### `microflow measure`

Measure geometry and intensity of every labelled object and write a CSV table.

Usage: `microflow measure <labels_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `labels_path` |  | Label image from `microflow segment`, one Y-X plane. |
| option | `--raw` |  | Raw intensity image: axes YX, or one channel axis C. |
| option | `--output` |  | Output CSV with one row per object. |
| option | `--corrected` |  | Corrected image on the same grid, e.g. from `microflow preprocess` without normalize. |
| option | `--pixel-size` |  | Pixel size; overrides the file's calibration. Needs --unit. |
| option | `--unit` |  | Length unit for --pixel-size: nm, um, mm or m. |
| option | `--require-calibration` | `False` | Fail rather than report pixel units when the image has no calibration. |

### `microflow qc-report`

Build a quality-control report: figures, segmentation summary and flagged results.

Usage: `microflow qc-report <input_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `input_path` |  | Raw image (TIFF or .npy). |
| option | `--labels` |  | Label image from `microflow segment`. |
| option | `--output` |  | Output self-contained HTML report. |
| option | `--preprocessed` |  | Preprocessed image on the same grid (optional). |
| option | `--qc-config` |  | YAML with quality-control thresholds. |
| option | `--png-dir` |  | Also write each figure as a PNG into this directory. |
| option | `--fail-on-flags` | `False` | Exit with status 2 if any result is flagged (for CI). |
| option | `--pixel-size` |  | Pixel size; overrides the file's calibration. Needs --unit. |
| option | `--unit` |  | Length unit for --pixel-size: nm, um, mm or m. |

### `microflow batch`

Process every image in a batch, with resume.

Usage: `microflow batch <config_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | Batch YAML configuration. |
| option | `--workers` |  | Images processed in parallel; overrides the configuration. |
| option | `--overwrite` | `False` | Replace results of a different analysis in the output directory. |

### `microflow serve`

Run the analysis HTTP service. Needs the 'service' extra and MICROFLOW_SERVICE_TOKEN.

Usage: `microflow serve <settings_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `settings_path` |  | Service settings YAML. |
| option | `--host` |  | Address to listen on; overrides the settings. |
| option | `--port` |  | Port; overrides the settings. |
| option | `--allow-remote` | `False` | Accept a non-loopback address. Put a TLS-terminating proxy in front. |

### `microflow verify-run`

Re-hash every input and output a run recorded and report any that are missing or changed.

Usage: `microflow verify-run <run_dir>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `run_dir` |  | Output directory of a finished batch run. |

### `microflow export`

Export a finished batch run as CSV and/or Parquet, with a data dictionary and provenance.

Usage: `microflow export <run_dir>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `run_dir` |  | Output directory of a batch run. |
| option | `--output` |  | Directory for the exported files. |
| option | `--format` |  | csv or parquet; repeat to choose several. |
| option | `--allow-partial` | `False` | Export successful images from a run that did not complete. |
| option | `--overwrite` | `False` | Replace exported results of a different analysis. |

### `microflow compare-configs`

List the settings that differ, and whether they change the analysis identity.

Usage: `microflow compare-configs <old> <new>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `old` |  | Batch configuration (the earlier one). |
| argument | `new` |  | Batch configuration (the later one). |

### `microflow cache-status`

Report which cached results remain valid for a configuration. Changes nothing.

Usage: `microflow cache-status <config_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | Batch YAML configuration. |

### `microflow make-sample-data`

Write deterministic synthetic TIFF images with calibration sidecars.

Usage: `microflow make-sample-data`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| option | `--out-dir` | `Path('data/synthetic')` | Destination directory. |
| option | `--seed` | `0` | Base random seed. |
| option | `--count` | `3` | Number of images to write. |

## `microflow ml` commands

### `microflow ml make-dataset`

Write a deterministic synthetic dataset (images, masks and a manifest).

Usage: `microflow ml make-dataset <out_dir>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `out_dir` |  | Directory to write images, masks and manifest. |
| option | `--samples` | `6` | Number of original samples. |
| option | `--images-per-sample` | `2` | Fields of view per sample. |
| option | `--size` | `64` | Image side length in pixels. |
| option | `--seed` | `0` | Seed for the generator. |

### `microflow ml splits`

Show which original samples fall in each split, without loading any pixels.

Usage: `microflow ml splits <config_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | Training YAML configuration. |

### `microflow ml train`

Train the U-Net, saving the best and the last checkpoint and the validation history.

Usage: `microflow ml train <config_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | Training YAML configuration. |
| option | `--device` |  | Override the configured device: cpu, cuda or auto. |
| option | `--overwrite` | `False` | Replace results of a different training run. |

### `microflow ml evaluate`

Score a checkpoint on the held-out test samples and write per-image metrics.

Usage: `microflow ml evaluate <config_path> <checkpoint>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | The training configuration used. |
| argument | `checkpoint` |  | A checkpoint written by ml train. |
| option | `--device` |  | Override the configured device: cpu, cuda or auto. |

### `microflow ml fingerprint`

Print the SHA-256 of a checkpoint. A segmenter plugin configuration must name it.

Usage: `microflow ml fingerprint <checkpoint>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `checkpoint` |  | A checkpoint file. |

### `microflow ml inspect`

Validate a checkpoint for this MicroFlow version and show what it declares.

Usage: `microflow ml inspect <checkpoint>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `checkpoint` |  | A checkpoint file. |

### `microflow ml segment`

Segment objects with a trained model. Writes the same outputs as `microflow segment`, plus an .ml.json report with the model, tiling, device and per-plane quality.

Usage: `microflow ml segment <checkpoint> <input_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `checkpoint` |  | A checkpoint written by ml train. |
| argument | `input_path` |  | Input TIFF or .npy image. |
| option | `--output` |  | Output label image (int32; 0 is background). |
| option | `--device` | `'auto'` | auto, cpu or cuda. |
| option | `--tile-size` | `256` | Window size in pixels; a multiple of 2**depth of the model. |
| option | `--overlap` |  | Pixels shared by neighbouring windows. Default: the receptive radius. |
| option | `--threshold` |  | Probability threshold. Default: the value recorded in the checkpoint. |
| option | `--min-area` | `4.0` | Minimum object area in --area-unit; 0 keeps every object. |
| option | `--area-unit` | `'um'` | Unit for --min-area: nm, um, mm or m. |
| option | `--exclude-border` | `False` | Drop objects that touch the image edge. |
| option | `--channel` |  | Channel index, for images with a C axis. |
| option | `--fallback-to-cpu/--no-fallback-to-cpu` | `True` | Move the rest of a run to CPU after a recoverable CUDA failure. |
| option | `--pixel-size` |  | Pixel size; overrides the file's calibration. Needs --unit. |
| option | `--unit` |  | Length unit for --pixel-size: nm, um, mm or m. |
| option | `--reference` |  | Ground-truth label image; reports Dice and IoU against it. |

### `microflow ml compare`

Compare two label images: overall Dice and IoU, and one-to-one object matches.

Usage: `microflow ml compare <ml_labels> <reference_labels>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `ml_labels` |  | A label image, for example from ml segment. |
| argument | `reference_labels` |  | Another label image, for example from microflow segment. |
| option | `--output` |  | Write the comparison as JSON to this path. |
| option | `--match-iou` | `0.5` | IoU needed for two objects to count as the same object. |

## `microflow stats` commands

### `microflow stats run`

Run the analysis described by a design file and write its tables and figures.

Usage: `microflow stats run <design>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `design` |  | Study design YAML. |
| option | `--overwrite` | `False` | Replace results of a different analysis. |
| option | `--no-plots` | `False` | Skip the figures. |

### `microflow stats check`

Check a design against its measurements and show each group's sample sizes.

Usage: `microflow stats check <design>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `design` |  | Study design YAML. |

### `microflow stats example`

Write the synthetic two-condition example measurements and data dictionary.

Usage: `microflow stats example <directory>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `directory` |  | Directory to write the example data to. |
| option | `--seed` | `0` | Seed for the generator. |

### `microflow stats report`

Write one self-contained HTML report: tables, figures, warnings and method notes.

Usage: `microflow stats report <results>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `results` |  | Output directory of a stats run. |
| option | `--output` |  | HTML file to write. |
| option | `--batch-dir` |  | Batch run that produced the measurements; links each image's QC report. |

## `microflow plugins` commands

### `microflow plugins list`

List installed plugins. Only package metadata is read; no plugin code is run.

Usage: `microflow plugins list`

### `microflow plugins check`

Load every plugin a configuration names and validate its options. Runs no images.

Usage: `microflow plugins check <config_path>`

| Kind | Name | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| argument | `config_path` |  | Batch YAML configuration. |
